title: Advances in next-generation electrochromic supercapacitors: emerging applications, challenges and future perspectives
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1917-1956
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01551G, Review Article
Lingaraj Pradhan, Tapas Kumar Das, Bikash Kumar Jena
This review covers the basic principles of electrochromic supercapacitor (EcSc) devices and studies on the recent development of materials for their fabrication, highlighting the key challenges and future perspectives to provide a holistic approach.
